text:
Type: smoked glass bottle vase
Use: holding a few stems or a single branch on a table, shelf or windowsill; living room, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern
Materials: tinted glass with a heavy base
Colors: smoky grey, deep charcoal at the bottom, translucent
Shape: squat round-shouldered bottle with a short neck and thick rolled lip, gradient tint darkening toward the base, compact and solid
Feel: calm, moody, refined, sleek
Goes with: dried flowers, green stems, light or dark wood, concrete, linen; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: BLADET
product.description: Mouth blown; each vase has been shaped by a skilled craftsman.
